correctness.rationale: For S³, the zonal normalized Gegenbauer/U_ell character is sin((ell+1)t)/((ell+1)sin t) and polar density sin²t, so for ell≥1 the averaging multiplier equals [sin(ell θ)/ell−sin((ell+2)θ)/(ell+2)]/[2(ell+1)V(θ)], V=θ/2−sin(2θ)/4>0. Vanishing at rational θ/π transforms, with n=ell+1≥2 and z=e^(2iθ), to P_n(z)=(n−1)z^(n+1)−(n+1)z^n+(n+1)z−(n−1). If four-term rational root-of-unity relation reduces, equal coefficient sizes force paired cancellations and z²=1; if irreducible, Mann's four-term theorem forces order(z)|6. Direct exact cyclotomic reductions at orders 1,2,3,6 exclude all except z=−1 with n odd. Hence all nonhemispherical rational cap angles have nonzero harmonic multipliers, while θ=π/2 kills precisely positive even ell; completeness of S³ harmonics identifies the full kernel. Multipliers decay O_θ(ell^(−2)), so injectivity does not imply a bounded inverse. Ends θ=0,π and irrational θ intentionally excluded.
